title: A longer revolution
hook: Change revolution period and predict angular speed.
misconception: angular speed doubles when revolution period doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply ω = 2π/T to compare angular speed when revolution period changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With uniform circular motion, ω = 2π/T. When revolution period doubles, angular speed becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model ω = 2π/T; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider uniform circular motion, with a nonzero initial result. If revolution period triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on angular speed?
recall.why: Apply ω = 2π/T under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
